recap.text: Gordo protects the Belly-Rubbed Pug, a renaissance-fair pub where rooms cost ten gold a night. Donut uses a charisma of 70 to make Gordo scurry into the kitchen for walnuts. Mordecai uses a potion to knock Gordo out so he can steal herbs and read a physical newsletter warning of a major battle event. Gordo returns with two bowls of lumpy oatmeal.

beats.headline: A family establishment
beats.text: For the record: Gordo, Bopca protector at the Belly-Rubbed Pug, a renaissance-fair pub of a saferoom where rooms now cost ten gold a night. Twenty minutes after the crawlers left their manager, he teleports in beside the bar with his pants at his knees, asking for Grannie first. Gordo, from behind the counter: "My good sir, I must ask you sheath your sword immediately!" This is a family establishment. Mordecai vomits on the floor, sits in it and passes out. Gordo leans over: this is their manager? Yep. A sad shake of the head. "You two are so dead."
beats.gist: Gordo protects Bopca at the Belly-Rubbed Pug, a renaissance-fair pub saferoom where rooms cost ten gold.

beats.headline: Right away, your majesty
beats.text: Crawler Carl's Earth Hobby Potion has given him a skill called Cesta Punta, and nobody knows what it is. Crawler Donut's theory: likely the art of cracking nuts with your toes. "Gordo, darling. Get me some walnuts. We need to experiment." Of course, right away, your majesty, and he scurries into the back kitchen. Crawler Carl's observation: Bopcas are subservient as a rule, and this one is even more so than usual. Crawler Donut's Charisma has rocketed up to 70.
beats.gist: Carl has a skill called Cesta Punta. Donut uses 70 Charisma to make Gordo fetch walnuts.

beats.headline: A draft for his dignity
beats.text: Morning. Gordo is passed out at a table beside the crawlers' manager, snoring like a chainsaw. Crawler Donut demands breakfast and a brushing. "Hold yer horses, ye blowhard." She can brush herself, princess. Asked whether Mordecai taught him the finger-breaking trick: no, Mordecai made him a potion from a few things behind his own bar, because he has not felt himself since the two crawlers arrived, and it would let him regain his dignity. It is not right, taking advantage of his kind nature like that. He disappears into the back.
beats.gist: Gordo snores like a chainsaw beside the manager while Donut demands breakfast and a brushing.

beats.headline: The newsletter in his kitchen
beats.text: Mordecai, over chat: the potion was meant to knock Gordo out so he could get into the kitchens and find the newsletter. Bopcas and shopkeepers have no access to the feed, so a physical brief is delivered after each recap episode. Mordecai read it and stole a few herbs for potions while he was there. This one is regional, and it warns of a potential major battle event in the area today or tonight. Eat, go, and never come back this way. Gordo returns with two bowls of what looks like lumpy oatmeal.
beats.gist: Mordecai uses a potion to knock out Gordo and steal herbs and a regional newsletter.
